question: Which local moves preserve future answers on closed signed strands, and what fails when two strands share an extra distinction?
inputs: All sign words and all four midpoint restrictions at lengths 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8. One dependency checkpoint, four named sources, publicly visible attachments, and the original nine clauses in notebook 36.
forbidden_inputs: No refit. Direct oracle answers and junction labels cannot enter cursor updates, checkpoint execution or the historical score.
mapping: Advance a cursor by one signed link or an exact block of at most two, compare serial and alternating visits, then join closed strands with distinct or identified intermediate variables.
primary_observable: Exact allowed sets, errors when skipping an interior sign, actual packet bits and answers, demanded source identities, action counts and underlying rule reads, and information lost if a shared variable is forgotten early.
comparators_or_controls: Full joint assignment enumeration, direct evaluation of the unchanged checkpoint, blind hop, common versus distinct intermediate identity, locally opposite versus semantically incompatible demands.
resource_budget: One bounded CPU census. No training or seed selection.
first_executable_signal: Two individually viable returns can agree on all possible boundary values while disagreeing on their shared intermediate value.
stop_rule: Record all cells including learned-policy failures, missed contradictions, and any differences between exact schedules.
